phase: 02: disjoint continuation over the prior checkpoint's 119 unread scoped paths
scope_policy: Pinned main8050 source. Incoming pilot migration is outside this audit checkpoint. No production fixes, prior-report rewrites, paid calls or private benchmark access.
method: A full_source_read entry means every line was displayed and substantively inspected, including embedded tests. Failed/truncated displays were reread; unread files are not promoted by parsing or passing tests. Mathematical arguments are explicitly source-derived, not mechanized implementation proofs. Public synthetic probe inputs contain no benchmark task material.

claims.claim: Remaining EIS legacy records, regex gates and clonal counters provide finite state/pattern checks; externally authenticated admission and independent danger observations are additional obligations.
limitations: Public status metadata is caller-authored.
A nonblank receipt string or a danger enum is not authentication.
No semantic detector completeness or statistical efficacy proved.

claims.claim: Pharmacy search binds a supplied catalog byte string and candidate byte string, filters declared scope/status/rule/admission fields, and deterministically ranks eligible records.
limitations: Retrieval is not activation.
Receipt syntax and hashes do not authenticate the source of a supplied catalog.
Duplicate JSON keys are not rejected by the generic Value parser.
Ranking scope/tag overlap is not a learned efficacy metric.

claims.claim: Host checks enforce a bounded JSON/lexical profile with duplicate-key detection and protected-name/persona marker matching.
limitations: Substring-based allowed roles can suppress matching persona markers.
No semantic entailment or truth check.
Literal slash paths are not escaped JSON Pointer.

claims.claim: Kernel capability closure is a finite subset/authority-ceiling check over normalized declared operations; its operation key framing and nested-entry interpretation have reproduced gaps.
limitations: No signature/lifecycle enforcement in authorize_term.
No proof actual executor effects equal declaration.
Tests establish only supplied finite inputs; no authority escalation in a production host was attempted.

claims.claim: For valid permutations, inverse routing and composition p[q[i]] preserve distinct input occurrences; external substitution maps the chosen planar slot and splices the inner ordering into the outer ordering.
limitations: Inspection argument, not mechanized Rust proof.
No new reindex parity run in this checkpoint.
Host execution still must bind the external order and authorize the underlying term.

claims.claim: Foundation tensor construction records concatenated input signatures and a named product output; TensorArityWitness certifies only positive factor arities and ordered input concatenation.
limitations: No tensor-output validation in witness.
No operation registration validation despite operad parameter.
No associator, unitor, interchange or executor concurrency proof.
Separate from the checked estate kernel.

claims.claim: Execution events and obligation bundles are canonical evidence/proposal records, not proof objects: obligation export always marks statements Open and does not invoke Lean.
limitations: No authenticated execution or parent-sequence verification.
Public nested budget fields bypass local constructor check.
Generic prose obligation generation does not enumerate all relevant substitutions/coherence diagrams.

claims.claim: On constructor-reachable states, ConvergenceMonitorV1 terminates accepted observations by a strictly decreasing natural budget and a terminal frozen state.
limitations: A finite stopping theorem, not population convergence.
Plateau checks exact equality of supplied snapshots, not monotone progress.
Recovery is declared, not performed.
Argument by source inspection, not Lean/Rust refinement proof.

claims.claim: Pareto sorting repeatedly removes all nondominated supplied candidates; the strict coordinatewise dominance relation has a maximal element on every nonempty finite set, so the partition loop progresses.
limitations: No causal learning, generalization or measured efficacy inferred.
Public scores and counters are not authenticated receipt credit.
Machine counter arithmetic/denominator validity need separate bounds.
No fresh full-suite run.

claims.claim: For finite declared reactions with unique ids, maximal_raf terminates and returns the greatest subset whose inputs and at least one catalyst per reaction lie in its uncatalyzed food closure.
limitations: Proof sketch: closure grows over a finite universe; active set only shrinks; any RAF subset survives every deletion by closure monotonicity; fixed point satisfies the conditions.
Not a mechanized proof of Rust.
Existence of a catalytic graph pattern is not biological or epistemic causal efficacy.

claims.claim: validate_independence checks traversed reference consistency, different generator/evaluator names, lineage reachability and existence of any external anchor; it does not certify statistical or causal independence.
limitations: Actor inequality is a string condition.
Digest fields are not recomputed against evidence bytes here.
One anchor anywhere permits self-fed branches elsewhere.
Unanchored unrelated traces can pass.

findings.title: Digest quorum accepts two threshold-qualified digests
findings.observation: try_new([aa,aa,aa,bb,bb],2) returns Ok with votes=3 although both aa and bb meet k=2.
findings.mechanism: leaders counts ties at the maximum, instead of the number of distinct values with votes>=k.
findings.limits: A local quorum contract violation; no authenticated observer voting or production exploit is shown.
findings.repair: Count all threshold-qualified distinct digests, require exactly one, retain that digest in the witness, and test unequal qualifying tallies.

findings.title: Distinct anti-skill pattern/scope pairs deterministically share an id
findings.observation: BoundaryLeakage rules (pattern a, scope bBoundaryLeakagec) and (pattern aBoundaryLeakageb, scope c) both receive ab_4092a86992000b74.
findings.mechanism: Schema, regex, Debug failure-class string and scope are concatenated without framing before SHA256 truncation.
findings.limits: This is an encoding collision, not a cryptanalytic collision. Formulary replacement risk is source-derived; no authenticated admission bypass is asserted.
findings.repair: Use an explicitly versioned structured or length-framed canonical encoding; preserve historical ids and record migration mapping rather than rewriting evidence.

findings.title: Entry nesting gate forgets an entry ancestor across a discipline operation
findings.observation: Entry(Discipline(Entry(input))) is authorized under a license permitting both operations; direct Entry(Entry(input)) is refused by existing tests.
findings.mechanism: Recursive traversal passes current_is_entry, losing a true ancestor flag when the current node is Discipline.
findings.limits: The refusal message says an entry may not contain another entry, while implementation forbids only adjacent entries. If adjacency is the intended rule, the contract must say so. No production executor authority effect was tested.
findings.repair: Resolve the documented nesting policy; for descendant exclusion propagate ancestor_is_entry||current_is_entry and add an intervening-discipline regression.

findings.title: Allowed operation keys conflate different id/version pairs
findings.observation: Operation (id=a@b, version=c) and (id=a, version=b@c) both have key a@b@c but different canonical ids; a license listing the first key authorizes the second operation.
findings.mechanism: Identifier grammar permits @ in both components while key() joins them with an unescaped @; authorization compares only this joined key for operation membership.
findings.limits: Executor/colour/tool/effect/authority checks still apply. This demonstrates operation-membership ambiguity, not unrestricted authority escalation.
findings.repair: Use an injective versioned pair encoding or bind allowed operations by canonical spec digest; reject delimiter ambiguity while preserving historical identifiers.

findings.title: Execution event accepts a budget transition its constructor rejects
findings.observation: BudgetTransition::new(1,2) refuses, but direct public BudgetTransition{before:1,after:2} is accepted by ExecutionEvent::new and is serializable in the event.
findings.mechanism: Budget fields are public, and the outer constructor copies input.budget without rechecking after<=before.
findings.limits: Event records do not themselves spend host resources; no production budget increase was attempted.
findings.repair: Make BudgetTransition fields private and/or revalidate the invariant in ExecutionEvent::new; test the public constructor boundary.

findings.title: SpanOperand constructor does not enforce its advertised integrity profile
findings.observation: SpanOperand::new with raw_text=a, byte_length=999 and content_sha256=not-a-digest succeeds; verify_integrity then returns false.
findings.mechanism: new checks line ordering and BOM but does not recompute digest/byte length or constrain colour to ADMITTED_FINITE_COLOURS; fields are public.
findings.limits: from_raw_text computes a correct digest and length, and verify_integrity detects the mismatch. No consuming execution path was shown to trust bad spans.
findings.repair: Separate explicitly unchecked data construction from a checked span type, or validate integrity/colour at construction and at deserialization; bind path/offset claims externally.

findings.title: Outcome reducer has undeclared empty-input and unknown-label behavior
findings.mechanism: all(TaskPass) is vacuously true for empty lists, and the refusal-required branch does not reject unknown mandatory labels.
findings.limits: This helper does not itself increment task_success_credit. Whether an empty mandatory set is a legitimate task is a host/specification question; no unearned credit is established.
findings.repair: Declare and enforce nonempty/allowed outcome-domain preconditions, or document vacuous tasks explicitly; use a closed outcome enum and test invalid labels.

validation.limits: Seven fresh synthetic cases. Probe reuses the existing offline build/rustc runner but replaces its program; previous checkpoint probes were not rerun. No full suite or Rust/Python parity suite rerun.
Previous EIS integration compilation error and stale fixture failures remain recorded there. This checkpoint does not promote them to passing or infer suite health from successful library build.

validation.result: All 119 source hashes match previous pinned checkpoint; git diff HEAD over these paths is empty. Twenty new full reads are disjoint from the prior full-read set; 99 remain unread.

file_reviews.assessment: Full ports, quorum algorithm and tests read. Danger observation/guard custody are host-supplied traits. DigestQuorum counts duplicate string votes with checked arithmetic; its leaders comparison enforces a unique maximum, not the documented unique threshold winner. Public synthetic counterexample reproduces acceptance of two qualifying digests.

Full module and embedded tests read. propose (79-107) creates Proposed/None metadata, crate-private promotion/admission methods (111-144) enforce local status transitions only. Public mutable/Deserialize fields are legacy records, not authenticated capabilities. Unframed digest encoding yields a reproduced pattern/scope identity collision. Generic capacity witness does not prove detector adequacy.

Full module and tests read. DetectorRule parsing enforces exact integer counters and finite nonnegative affinity (52-85). Decay is an idle-count cutoff (89-98), mutation resets status/counters (99-110), exact stimulation leaves the rule unchanged except float-boost refusal (111-144), autonomous decay refuses (147-152). Anergy queues proposals and never suspends (153-170). No probabilistic clonal-selection or semantic adaptation theorem; apply_decay may reactivate an already inactive caller-authored rule.

Full module and tests read. evaluate (55-98) checks Admitted status, regex hit and presence of a supplied IndependentDangerSignal enum. Invalid regex returns a Retired-labelled refusal without mutating the borrowed spec. No independent observer provenance or scope check is performed here; semantic independence is an external assumption.

Full module and tests read. Private maps hold legacy Candidate-to-Admitted metadata with nonblank receipt string (33-78). Module expressly excludes signer, expiry, revocation and rule-byte binding (1-7). Registering an existing id overwrites entries; active filtering is status-only. This is not authenticated admission and no such bypass is inferred.

Full module and tests read. Ordered JSON parsing rejects duplicate keys, limits raw bytes/depth and scans protected field/persona patterns (11-156); lexical span scan handles quotes/escapes (175-253). Persona allowance is substring based, so a supplied allowed-role substring can suppress a marker finding. These finite syntactic detectors are not semantic authority/hallucination validators; path labels are not escaped JSON Pointer.

Full module including generated capacity test read in two complete chunks. Validates bounded query/catalog bytes, exact byte digest, scope/tag overlap, admitted metadata, rule digest/regex, optional expiry/revocation (113-274,375-418); ranks by smaller declared scope, greater tag overlap, id (303-335). Optional candidate regex hits bind subject bytes with 64-hit cap per selected rule (337-373). Trusted snapshot and admission provenance are supplied; digest syntax/checks are not signature verification. serde_json Value parsing is last-wins for duplicate object keys, and selection is retrieval, not activation or semantic efficacy.

priorities: Kernel cells and observer, and their integration tests; validate higher-cell soundness/evidence binding separately.

nonclaims: No completion of the every-file audit.
No new empirical detector/learning efficacy result.

No production exploitation or authenticated signature bypass.
No review of incoming pilot migration corpus.
source_concerns_not_yet_reproduced: Public model/license/refusal fields permit bypass of constructor validation; consumers need a separate trust-boundary audit.
Host persona exemption uses allowed-role substring membership, including empty strings if caller supplies them; inspect policy ownership before classifying as a security defect.
Clonal apply_decay recalculates active status without preserving an explicit inactive state; inspect intended lifecycle ownership.
PromptFitness u64 counters and passes+failures arithmetic need enforced input bounds; not probed in this pass.
Pharmacy serde_json Value catalog parsing permits duplicate keys and relies on trusted catalog snapshot provenance.
